theorems.name: Submission.cbrr_tcd_cone_cutoff_exists
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → ∃ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Euclid P) ℝ, (∀ y, 0 ≤ f y) ∧ (∀ y, f y ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ y : Euclid P, 2 * ‖Q.starProjection y‖ < ‖y‖ → ‖y‖ < 1 → f y = 1) ∧ ∀ y ∈ Q, δ < ‖y‖ → f y = 0
